observed_title: An Easy Proof of a Weak Version of Chernoff Inequality
version: arXiv:2507.02759v2; watermark4 July2025, title date8 July2025; 2 pages

read_ranges.scope: Whole paper: theorem/lemma, proof, remarks and complete references

theorem_cards.label: Weak fair-coin lower tail
assumptions: M is a positive integer; 6M independent fair coin indicators Ci.
proof_steps: ΣCi≤M iff Y_{6M}≥1; apply Markov and (3/4)^3≤1/2. This is a multiplicative exponential test, not a sharp optimized Chernoff coefficient.
gaps: Main proof is self-contained. The QuickSort remark claims an unprinted careful3/4 conditional contraction, while its footnote gives only7/8; do not present the remark as a verified universal quicksort theorem.
Y_i may be fractional after more than M heads, despite the informal integer balls language; interpret it as positive mass.

transfer_boundary: Only this fair-coin threshold is directly supplied; a general biased/martingale inequality needs its own mgf/conditional contraction. Correlated fair marginals do not meet the conditional expectation. PDFp1 visual check retained.
proof_verification: local derivations and literal errors checked; cited external results not independently certified
